title: Prime Minister congratulates Suchika Tariyal on winning Bronze in Mixed Martial Arts at Asian Games
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Suchika Tariyal on winning a Bronze medal in Mixed Martial Arts at the Asian Games, calling it a historic achievement for India.
The Prime Minister noted that she has secured India’s first-ever Asian Games medal in this field. He stated that her achievement is especially significant, highlighting her dedication and zeal, and extended his best wishes for many more successes ahead.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared:
"A historic achievement for India!
Congratulations to Suchika Tariyal on winning a Bronze in Mixed Martial Arts and securing India’s first-ever Asian Games medal in this field. Her achievement is especially significant, highlighting her dedication and zeal.
Best wishes for many more successes ahead: PM @narendramodi"
